scope: Supplemental plan-to-built comparison, direction-probe viewing and blind-finding disposition review. This does not certify pre-build chronology, human approval, publication or every upstream workflow stage.

evidence: 5 declared roles match hook, linear worked example, binary worked example, full-target evidence and conditions recap.
Each of the five takeaways matches visible text and the independently recomputed data; local provenance is appropriate.
The accepted worked-comparison arc starts concretely before introducing conditions; the two rejected arcs pose genuinely different learner questions.
content_plan_audit.qualification: The plan was documented after the built candidate; it is a present consistency audit, not evidence that planning checkpoints preceded authoring.

directions.observation: A full ordered number row and two comparison counts make the same data visible; matches final slides 1 and 2 and develops into aligned rows on slide 3.
directions.judgment: Best fit among these rendered probes for this teaching goal.

directions.observation: Textual terminal traces show order but do not spatially expose which values are excluded.
directions.judgment: Reasonable rejection for first-time learners; not a claim that terminal teaching is universally inferior.

directions.observation: 13-versus-4 bar lengths communicate magnitude but omit the search process.
directions.judgment: Could be a result inset; insufficient as the governing method explanation.

directions.observation: Four offset value blocks suggest a path; no complete 15-value range or excluded half is visible.
directions.judgment: Reasonable rejection; this probe is a path sketch rather than a fully connected decision tree.

directions.observation: Legible chalkboard cover with texture and large Japanese title; the array-range demonstration is absent from this single probe.
directions.judgment: A is the more directly evidenced fit here; a cover-only E probe cannot prove that the chalkboard system could not support good array diagrams.

design_plan_audit.signature: Actual same-position comparisons are strongest within slide 3. Slides 1–2 establish the ordered-number vocabulary; their cell geometry differs from slide 3, so carried_by=[1,2,3] means shared concept, not identical coordinates across all slides.
design_plan_audit.palette: White canvas, navy text, blue/brown emphasis and pale array fills match the current plan.
design_plan_audit.static: selfread/static purpose is consistent with the final all-visible diagrams; no animation needed.
design_plan_audit.icon_decision: Literal numbers are data identities, not pictographic categories. No icon family is needed and none was promised.

legibility.evidence: All five final PNGs were actually opened in the prior full review and their hashes remain unchanged. Footers are small but intact. Chart labels and axes are readable on-screen; blind answers independently transcribed them and reported no unreadable strings.
legibility.limit: No back-of-room/projector readability claim. For future projection enlarge footer and chart labels, especially the comparison-count definition. Small-footnote reports on slides 2, 3 and 5 did not explicitly mention projection, so blanket wording claiming all reports did is too strong.

sameness.evidence: Slide 3 is a four-row worked process; slide 5 is a two-column conditions/limits recap. Shared binary-search topic does not imply visual or argumentative sameness.

none_icon_cli.evidence: planned_icon_family() maps none-prefixed prose to an empty family. compare(record=...) invokes that normalization, but CLI main passes raw gates.content and gates.design_plan to compare without record. Its nonempty fam and zero-icons test therefore flags literal none incorrectly. Read source around lines 285–303, 392–407, 545–575 and 782.

concerns.issue: type_scale display46/title26/body24 does not enumerate the actual 66-point hero and other measured text sizes.
concerns.recommendation: Treat these as representative roles, or label the plan scale representative and point to the measured font histogram. Do not claim exact token conformance.

concerns.issue: Footnote smallness is real; intended selfread delivery makes it acceptable. Not every blind report explicitly said projection.
concerns.recommendation: Prefer accepted for selfread over refuted for the generic small-footnote findings.

concerns.issue: E is a cover-only chalkboard demonstration; no like-for-like four-step array proof was rendered in that style.
concerns.recommendation: State A was selected from these five actual probes; do not generalize that the original chalkboard style cannot support the lesson.
